subTasks.text: Evaluate the Clockwork Clover Robotics materials for retirement contribution opportunities, tax considerations, insurance gaps after Aaron Bramblequill's death, HSA eligibility, cash-flow impact, and coordination with Sera's existing coverage.

subTasks.title: Prepare client decision summary
subTasks.text: Summarize key health, life, disability, and beneficiary elections for Sera Bramblequill, unresolved questions, and any items she should confirm with the Clockwork Clover Robotics benefits administrator before submitting choices.

subTasks.title: Document final elections for planning file
subTasks.text: After Sera Bramblequill confirms submission of her Clockwork Clover Robotics elections, record the selected benefits categories, planning assumptions, and follow-up items for future review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up for employer benefits after loss of spouse is due 2025-09-24.

tickets.text: Use this workflow to resolve the missing signature package for Sera Bramblequill's 2017 revocable living trust, which is otherwise complete but lacks a short certification of trust and trustee acceptance pages needed for custodian and bank retitling. Confirm the exact missing items with Lavender Sprocket Law, send a focused follow-up, and document completion before retitling requests proceed.

subTasks.title: Identify missing signature requirements
subTasks.text: Review the 2017 trust agreement binder and note each missing signature, date, initial, witness, notary, or capacity indicator required for the short certification of trust and trustee acceptance pages used in custodian and bank retitling.

subTasks.title: Send targeted signature instructions
subTasks.text: Contact Lavender Sprocket Law with the specific pages, signature blocks, and return method needed for the short certification of trust and trustee acceptance pages for Sera Bramblequill. Include placeholders for secure link, mailing address, or upload instructions.

subTasks.title: Confirm corrected package is complete
subTasks.text: Upon receipt, compare the updated trust certification and trustee acceptance pages against the original deficiency list and mark each item resolved before submission to Velvet Acorn Custody, Teacup Comet Bank, and other retitling parties.
